Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
q.e: Statements marked correct: 3.

q.q: The currency of Iran is the:

q.e: Statements marked correct: none.

q.e: Statements marked correct: none.

q.q: Which of the following is a landlocked country?
q.e: Nepal is a landlocked country.

q.q: The warm ocean current off the southeast coast of Africa is the _____ Current.
q.e: The warm ocean current off the southeast coast of Africa is the Agulhas Current.

q.q: The largest coral reef system in the world is the:
q.e: The largest coral reef system in the world is the Great Barrier Reef.

q.q: Which of the following is a monument located in India?
q.e: Taj Mahal is a monument located in India.

q.e: The capital of Jamaica is Kingston.

q.q: Japan Standard Time is UTC:
q.e: Japan Standard Time is UTC +9.

q.q: If f(x) = -3x + 5, the value of x for which f(f(x)) = 8 is:
q.e: f(f(x)) = 9x + -10; solve for x = 2.

q.q: The number of integers x satisfying x² + 7x + 0 < 0 is:
q.e: Roots -7 and 0; integers strictly between: 6.

q.q: A pipe fills a tank in 9 hours. Because of a leak at the bottom the tank takes 10 hours to fill. In how many hours would the leak alone empty the full tank?
q.e: Leak rate = 1/9 − 1/10; time = 90 hours.

q.q: The present ages of A and B are in the ratio 5:3. After 5 years the ratio will be 3:2. What is the sum of their present ages?

The percentage change in the production of Rice from 2019 to 2020 is (a decrease is negative):

The radii of the ends of a frustum of a cone are 7 cm and 4 cm and its height is 4 cm. Its curved surface area is (in cm²):
q.e: Slant height = √(4²+3²) = 5 cm; use π(R+r)l or πh(R²+Rr+r²)/3.

q.q: If 3^(x+1) − 3^x = 162, then x equals:
A train running at 90 km/h crosses a platform 250 m long in 22 seconds. The length of the train (in metres) is:
q.e: Distance covered = speed × time = 550 m; train length = 550 − 250 = 300 m.

q.q: The variance of the first 5 natural numbers 1, 2, …, 5 is:
q.e: Variance = (n²−1)/12 = 2.

q.q: A trader marks his goods 75% above the cost price and allows two successive discounts of 20% and 5%. His profit or loss percentage on the cost price is (a loss is shown as a negative figure):
Statement: P < T ≤ U < X < Q. Conclusions: I. U = P  II. X > U  III. P ≥ U. Which of the conclusions is/are definitely true?
o: Only II and III are true
q.e: A conclusion is definitely true only if it holds for every set of values consistent with the whole chain.

q.q: In a certain code language, A + B means A is the mother of B; A × B means A is the father of B; A − B means A is the brother of B; A ÷ B means A is the sister of B. If G + P + H, then how is G related to H?
q.e: Translate each sign and chain the relations: G is the grandmother of H.

q.q: How many leap years are there from 1950 to 2100 (both inclusive)?
q.e: Divisible by 4 minus centuries not divisible by 400: 37.

q.q: Find the wrong number in the series: 2, 9, 31, 65, 126, 217, 344
q.e: The correct series (nth term = n³ + 1) has 28 in place of 31.

q.q: What comes next? C, D, F, I, M, R, ?
q.e: Gaps grow by 1 each time: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6.

q.q: In a class of 45 students, Hira is 27th from the top and Zara is 22nd from the bottom. How many students are there between them?
q.e: Zara is 24th from the top (45+1−22); between = |24−27|−1.

q.q: If the letters of the word FOUNDATION are arranged in alphabetical order (repeated letters counted each time), which letter is 4th from the right?
q.e: Alphabetical order: ADFINNOOTU.

q.q: A solid wooden cube of edge 4 cm has all six faces painted and is then cut into 64 unit cubes. How many of the unit cubes have exactly 2 painted face(s)?
q.e: Classify the unit cubes by position (corners, edges, face centres, interior) and count the painted faces each has.

q.q: On an island every inhabitant is either a knight (always tells the truth) or a knave (always lies). Rabia says: "Nida is a knave." Nida says: "Exactly 1 of the 4 of us is a knight." Kamran says: "Kamran is a knight." Mehwish says: "Exactly one of Rabia and Mehwish is a knight." What is Mehwish?
o: both a knight and a knave
q.e: Only one knight/knave assignment is consistent with all the statements.

q.q: What is the value of x? (x and y are positive integers.) I. The sum of x and y is 33. II. x + 2y = 53.
o: Statement I alone is sufficient, but statement II alone is not
Both statements together are sufficient, but neither alone is
Statement II alone is sufficient, but statement I alone is not
Even both statements together are not sufficient
q.e: Test each statement alone, then both together, by checking whether exactly one value of the unknown remains.

q.q: Statements: No file is a tree. All files are birds. All coins are birds. Conclusions: I. No coin is a bird.  II. All trees are coins.  III. All birds are coins.  IV. Some coins are files. Which of the conclusions definitely follow(s)?
q.e: Draw all possible Venn diagrams for the three statements; a conclusion follows only if it holds in every one of them.

q.q: If '+' means '×', '−' means '−', '×' means '+', '÷' means '÷', then the value of 3 × 10 − 5 − 15 − 7 is:
q.e: Replace each sign by its meaning: 3 + 10 − 5 − 15 − 7 = -14 (BODMAS applies).
